note.summary:
2.1 Free-time activities
Key focus
- hobbies, music, sport, entertainment and leisure preferences.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use verbs of liking, frequency adverbs and justified opinions; narrate past events in a clear sequence.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: खाली समय में मैं एक छोटे संगीत समूह में गिटार बजाता हूँ।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

In my free time I play guitar in a small music group.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: शनिवार को मैं सहेलियों के साथ खेल-केंद्र में वॉलीबॉल खेलती हूँ।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

On Saturdays I play volleyball with my friends at the sports centre.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मुझे हास्य फ़िल्में पसंद हैं क्योंकि वे मुझे स्कूल की चिंता से मुक्त करती हैं।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I like comedy films because they help me forget worries about school.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.

Translate into Hindi:

Last Saturday we watched a concert, but the tickets were expensive.

Translate into Hindi:

I hardly ever watch television on weekdays.

questions.modelAnswer: इस गर्मी में मैं समुद्र में सर्फ़िंग सीखूँगा और रोज़ तट पर जाऊँगा।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

This summer I will learn to surf and go to the beach every day.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
खाली समय में मैं एक छोटे संगीत समूह में गिटार बजाता हूँ। शनिवार को मैं सहेलियों के साथ खेल-केंद्र में वॉलीबॉल खेलती हूँ। मुझे हास्य फ़िल्में पसंद हैं क्योंकि वे मुझे स्कूल की चिंता से मुक्त करती हैं। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: In my free time I play guitar in a small music group. On Saturdays I play volleyball with my friends at the sports centre. I like comedy films because they help me forget worries about school. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
